{{Quote|What have we done?|The Quarren to a stormtrooper|<ref name="WG" />}}
This  [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] '''individual''' resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WG" /> 

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Quarren was present at the [[Azure Dianoga Cantina]], located in the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Alien Protection Zone]] of Coruscant, sharing drinks with another Quarren and a tall [[Unidentified Duros (Azure Dianoga)|Duros]]. A squad of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] entered the cantina to conduct a routine inspection. The [[Unidentified stormtrooper leader (Azure Dianoga)|squad leader]] demanded [[Identichip/Legends|identification cards]] from all three patrons, scanned each card on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and returned only the Duros's card. Both Quarren were instructed to accompany the stormtroopers out of the cantina, with assurances that that they have nothing to fear if they haven't done anything wrong.<ref name="WG" /> 

In reality, the stormtroopers were acting under orders from [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]], who directed Imperial forces to round up Quarrens in the undercity to serve as test subjects for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Evir Derricote]]'s experiment to create the [[Krytos virus]].<ref name="WG" />
